title: International Postgraduate Diploma in International Marketing Strategy (Level 7)
description: The encapsulated International Postgraduate Diploma in International Marketing Strategy is for high-performance managers and directors who work in critical roles using available resources to produce products and services that satisfy the customers effectively.
longDescription: Course Overview The GSS International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in International Marketing Strategy allows you to update your skills, develop new skills, and explore and develop interests in various topics. These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. The encapsulated International Postgraduate Diploma in International Marketing Strategy is for high-performance managers and directors who work in critical roles using available resources to effectively produce products and services in a way that satisfies the customers. The Programme is also useful for managers and directors who need an intensive course to cover the key areas that drive success and profit in everyday business marketing. This Programme is designed to give you a comprehensive understanding of the key skills and practices used by marketing executives and their organizations to make informed marketing decisions vital to any business's success. Participants will learn how to critically evaluate key marketing models and apply them to a real-life business problem at a strategic level.
courseDetails: Mode of Study: Blended Assessment: Research-based Assignments The International Post Graduate Diploma in Entertainment And Media qualification aims to develop strategic management and leadership skills for managers with the authority and personal attributes to translate media and communication strategy into effective operational performance. This qualification reflects current practices in media and entertainment and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of and management in the media, communication and entertainment industry. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme consists of 6 modules with a total of 120 credits.

modules.title: MARKETING COMMUNICATION
modules.summary: In this course of Marketing communication we will explores the various methods and strategies used to effectively promote and sell products or services to a target audience. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the key principles and techniques involved in developing successful marketing campaigns, including advertising, public relations, social media, and branding. Students will also learn how to analyze consumer behavior, develop messaging and creative content, and measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts.

lessons.title: Strategic Role of Branding in Marketing Communication

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL MARKETING
modules.summary: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing is designed to fit around work and personal commitments. World-class teaching is delivered via pre-recorded online lectures to enrich the learning experience. GSS has perfected the art of delivering practical marketing management education. Our practice-based approach focuses on addressing real-world marketing and communication problems. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, business simulations, and 100% project-based. The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing allows you to achieve the qualification between 8 to 10 months, so it is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The purpose of this programme is to deliver an enhanced view of the marketing concepts and practices aimed at steering your business to new heights of reach and customization, which in turn is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.

lessons.title: Nature and Scope of International Marketing
Trade Distortion and the Marketing Barriers

modules.title: MARKETING MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: In this course, students will learn how to identify market opportunities, analyze consumer behavior, and develop effective marketing strategies to meet customer needs and achieve business goals. Topics covered in the course may include market research, product development, pricing strategies, distribution channels, and promotion tactics. Students will also gain an understanding of how to measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts and adjust strategies accordingly.

modules.title: ADVANCED BUSINESS RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The aim of this course is to develop learners’ ability to prepare for various types of academically based management research through the development and design of a research proposal. Learners will develop a critical understanding of the philosophical, practical and ethical concepts of research within the context of the business environment.

modules.title: STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP
modules.summary: Through this course, students will gain an understanding of how to formulate and implement effective business strategies, develop organizational structures, and create a culture of innovation and excellence. The course will also cover topics such as decision-making, risk management, and ethical leadership. Students will learn how to analyze the competitive landscape, identify opportunities for growth, and develop strategies that leverage their organization's strengths to achieve success.

lessons.title: Understanding the Principles, Concepts, and Approaches to Leadership
CASE STUDY - King of the Hill
Understanding Leadership Influences: Individual, Team and The Organisation
CASE STUDY - How Google builds the perfect team
Ethical Decision Making And Organisational Value
CASE STUDY - Collaboration Shifts a Dysfunctional Culture

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the key principles and strategies involved in managing international business operations, including market entry strategies, global supply chain management, cross-cultural communication, and international trade regulations. Students will also learn how to analyze global market trends, assess risk factors, and develop effective strategies for competing in a global marketplace.
